articles.title: 2026 AHA/ACC/ACCP/ACEP/CHEST/SCAI/SHM/SIR/SVM/SVN Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Acute Pulmonary Embolism in Adults: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Joint Committee on Clinical Practice Guidelines.
articles.conclusionEn: It addresses evidence-based diagnostic and management strategies (including pharmacological therapies, advanced interventional therapies, and in-hospital support) for acute PE and associated outcomes.
articles.punchTr: 2026 AHA/ACC akut pulmoner emboli kılavuzu: tanıdan ileri girişimsel tedaviye güncel kanıta dayalı yol haritası.

articles.title: Medical Management and Revascularization for Asymptomatic Carotid Stenosis.
articles.conclusionEn: Among patients with high-grade stenosis without recent symptoms, the addition of stenting led to a lower risk of a composite of perioperative stroke or death or ipsilateral stroke within 4 years than intensive medical management alone. Carotid endarterectomy did not lead to a significant benefit.
articles.punchTr: Asemptomatik yüksek dereceli karotis darlığında stent eklemek, 4 yılda inme/ölüm riskini yoğun medikal tedaviye göre azalttı.

articles.title: Transcatheter or Surgical Aortic-Valve Replacement in Low-Risk Patients at 7 Years.
articles.conclusionEn: Among low-risk patients with severe, symptomatic aortic stenosis, no significant differences with respect to two primary composite end points involving death, stroke, and rehospitalization were observed at 7 years between those who had undergone TAVR and those who had undergone surgery.
articles.punchTr: Düşük riskli aort darlığında TAVR ile cerrahi arasında 7 yılda ölüm, inme ve yeniden yatışta anlamlı fark çıkmadı.

articles.title: European Society for Vascular Surgery (ESVS) 2026 Clinical Practice Guidelines on the Management of Descending Thoracic and Thoraco-Abdominal Aortic Diseases - Editor's Choice.
articles.conclusionEn: These clinical practice guidelines provide comprehensive, up to date advice to clinicians and patients on the management of descending thoracic and thoraco-abdominal aortic pathologies.
articles.punchTr: ESVS 2026: inen torakal ve torakoabdominal aort hastalıklarının yönetiminde yeni Avrupa kılavuzu yayımlandı.

articles.title: Ultrasound-Facilitated, Catheter-Directed Fibrinolysis for Acute Pulmonary Embolism.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients with acute, intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism, ultrasound-facilitated, catheter-directed fibrinolysis plus anticoagulation led to a lower risk of the composite of pulmonary embolism-related death, cardiopulmonary decompensation or collapse, or symptomatic recurrence of pulmonary embolism within 7 days than anticoagulation alone.
articles.punchTr: Orta riskli PE'de ultrason destekli kateter trombolizi, 7 günlük kötü sonuçları tek başına antikoagülasyona göre azalttı.

articles.title: Randomized Controlled Trial of Mechanical Thrombectomy With Anticoagulation Versus Anticoagulation Alone for Acute Intermediate-High Risk Pulmonary Embolism: Primary Outcomes From the STORM-PE Trial.
articles.conclusionEn: CAVT was superior to anticoagulation alone in reducing RV/LV ratio within 48 hours in patients with intermediate-high risk PE, accompanied by earlier normalization of vital signs and major adverse event rates comparable to those for anticoagulation.
articles.punchTr: Orta-yüksek riskli PE'de mekanik trombektomi, 48 saatte RV/LV oranını antikoagülasyondan daha iyi düşürdü.

articles.title: Physiology vs angiography-guided percutaneous coronary intervention in transcatheter aortic valve implantation: the FAITAVI trial.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients undergoing TAVI with intermediate coronary lesions, FFR-guided PCI was associated with a reduced risk of MACCE at 12 months. These findings support a physiology-based revascularization strategy in this frail, elderly population.
articles.punchTr: TAVI hastasında orta koroner lezyonda FFR rehberli PCI, 12 ayda majör olayları anjiyografi rehberine göre azalttı.

articles.title: Bleeding Risk with Apixaban vs. Rivaroxaban in Acute Venous Thromboembolism.
articles.conclusionEn: Among patients with acute venous thromboembolism, the risk of clinically relevant bleeding was significantly lower with apixaban than with rivaroxaban during the 3-month treatment period.
articles.punchTr: Akut VTE'de apiksaban, 3 aylık tedavide klinik anlamlı kanamayı rivaroksabana göre belirgin azalttı.

articles.title: ACADM-mediated fatty acid β-oxidation pathway in atherosclerosis and abdominal aortic aneurysm.
articles.conclusionEn: These findings define previously unrecognized distinct lipid metabolic characteristics in the pathogenesis of AS vs AAA, providing a basis for differential diagnosis and targeted treatments.
articles.punchTr: Ateroskleroz ve AAA'da yağ asidi β-oksidasyonu farklı işliyor; ayırıcı tanı ve hedefe yönelik tedaviye kapı aralıyor.

articles.title: Long Term Real World Performance of the Gore Excluder AAA Endoprosthesis Featuring the C3 Delivery System: Ten Year Results from the European C3 Module of the GREAT Registry.
articles.conclusionEn: The Gore C3 Excluder shows long term safety and durability for infrarenal aortic disease, with low rates of aortic related death and major aortic events. These findings support its effectiveness in a real world setting. However, surveillance adherence remains challenging in daily practice.
articles.punchTr: Gore C3 Excluder 10 yıllık gerçek yaşam verisinde güvenli ve dayanıklı; ancak takibe uyum hâlâ zorluk.

articles.title: Outcomes following Revascularisation for Acute Lower Limb Ischaemia Using Contemporary Endovascular, Hybrid, or Open Surgical Techniques in a Multicentre, Retrospective Cohort: The Acute Lower Limb Ischaemia Vascular Outcomes Evaluation (ALIVE) Registry.
articles.conclusionEn: Endovascular ALLI intervention was associated with lower long term amputation risk compared with open surgery, with comparable survival. These findings support endovascular treatment as a safe alternative in patients with ALLI.
articles.punchTr: Akut bacak iskemisinde endovasküler tedavi, açık cerrahiye göre uzun dönem amputasyon riskini azalttı, sağkalım benzer.

articles.title: Percutaneous transcatheter valve replacement in individuals with mitral regurgitation unsuitable for surgery or transcatheter edge-to-edge repair: a prospective, multicountry, single-arm trial.
articles.conclusionEn: Percutaneous transseptal TMVR with the SAPIEN M3 system effectively reduced mitral regurgitation with low rates of complications and mortality. These findings support percutaneous TMVR with the SAPIEN M3 system as a therapeutic option for patients who are unsuitable for surgery or TEER.
articles.punchTr: Cerrahi ve TEER'e uygun olmayan mitral yetmezlikte perkütan SAPIEN M3 TMVR, düşük komplikasyonla yetmezliği azalttı.

articles.title: Editor's Choice - Open versus Endovascular Revascularisation for Femoropopliteal Disease in Patients with Chronic Limb Threatening Ischaemia.
articles.conclusionEn: Open FP bypass with an SSGSV conduit provides the most effective revascularisation for patients with CLTI due to advanced FP disease.
articles.punchTr: İleri femoropopliteal hastalığa bağlı KLTI'de safen ven greftli açık bypass en etkili revaskülarizasyon oldu.

articles.title: Midterm Outcomes of the Knickerbocker Technique following Thoracic Endovascular Aortic Repair for Chronic Post-dissection Thoracic Aortic Aneurysms: A Single Centre Experience.
articles.conclusionEn: KB appears to be a safe and effective adjunct to TEVAR to manage post-dissection TAA.
articles.punchTr: Diseksiyon sonrası torakal anevrizmada Knickerbocker tekniği, TEVAR'a güvenli ve etkili bir yardımcı görünüyor.

articles.title: 5-Year Outcomes of the Dissected Aorta Repair Through Stent (DARTS) Implantation Trial.
articles.conclusionEn: The 5-year outcomes of the DARTS trial demonstrate the safety and efficacy of the AMDS. Measures of aortic growth were generally favorable, with the majority of patients experiencing positive aortic remodeling over 5 years.
articles.punchTr: DARTS 5 yıl: AMDS stenti güvenli ve etkili; hastaların çoğunda aort olumlu yeniden şekillendi.

articles.title: Midterm Outcomes of In Situ and In Vitro Fenestrated Stent-Grafts for Endovascular Repair of Aortic Arch Pathologies.
articles.conclusionEn: For patients with aortic arch pathologies, in situ and in vitro fenestration techniques revealed comparable early and midterm results.
articles.punchTr: Aort arkı patolojilerinde in situ ve in vitro fenestrasyon, erken ve orta dönemde benzer sonuç verdi.

articles.title: Deferral of percutaneous coronary intervention in patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation (PRO-TAVI): an investigator-initiated, multicentre, open-label, non-inferiority, randomised controlled trial.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients with coronary artery disease undergoing TAVI, deferral of PCI was non-inferior to PCI before TAVI for the 1-year composite of all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, stroke, and major bleeding.
articles.punchTr: TAVI öncesi PCI'ı ertelemek, 1 yıllık ölüm, MI, inme ve kanama bileşiğinde önce PCI yapmaktan aşağı kalmadı.

articles.title: Histone Lactylation-Mediated Metabolic Remodeling in Vascular Smooth Muscle Cells Aggravates Aortic Aneurysm and Dissection by Promoting Lactate Accumulation.
articles.conclusionEn: Histone lactylation changes the metabolism and phenotype of VSMC in AAD. Inhibition of PDK1 or KAT7 may be a novel approach to treat or prevent AAD.
articles.punchTr: Histon laktilasyonu aort anevrizması ve diseksiyonunu kötüleştiriyor; PDK1 ya da KAT7 inhibisyonu yeni tedavi hedefi olabilir.

articles.title: Type A aortic dissection during pregnancy and postpartum: Experience in 60 patients over 25 years.
articles.conclusionEn: For TAAD occurring after 28 GWs, adequate maternal and fetal survival can be achieved with delivery followed by aortic repair, preferably in one stage.
articles.punchTr: Gebelikte tip A diseksiyon: 28. haftadan sonra doğum ardından tercihen tek seansta aort onarımıyla anne-bebek sağkalımı iyi.

articles.title: Hybrid Revascularization With Robotic Totally Endoscopic Coronary Bypass and Stents: What Are the Outcomes When The Stent Does Not Happen?
articles.conclusionEn: In a propensity score-matched cohort of patients undergoing robotic TECAB, omission of PCI as part of HCR did not have a negative impact on midterm survival, repeated revascularization, or major adverse events.
articles.punchTr: Robotik TECAB'da hibrit plandaki PCI'ın atlanması orta dönem sağkalımı ve majör olayları olumsuz etkilemedi.

articles.title: Age-Adjusted D-Dimer Cutoff Levels to Rule Out Deep Vein Thrombosis.
articles.conclusionEn: The age-adjusted D-dimer cutoff may safely rule out DVT and was associated with a larger number of patients in whom DVT could be effectively ruled out.
articles.punchTr: Yaşa göre ayarlı D-dimer eşiği DVT'yi güvenle dışlıyor ve daha fazla hastada görüntülemeyi gereksiz kılıyor.

articles.title: Carotid plaque macrophage burden and inflammatory lipid-associated macrophage markers predict secondary major adverse cardiovascular events after endarterectomy.
articles.conclusionEn: Together, these findings provide critical insights into the functional differences and origin of macrophage subpopulations in human atherosclerosis and show their clinical significance and risk prediction value in relation to future cardiovascular events.
articles.punchTr: Karotis plağındaki makrofaj yükü ve inflamatuvar belirteçler, gelecekteki kardiyovasküler olayları öngörüyor.

articles.title: Cryopreserved vs Liquid-Stored Platelets for the Treatment of Surgical Bleeding: The CLIP-II Randomized Noninferiority Clinical Trial.
articles.conclusionEn: Cryopreserved platelets did not meet the predefined threshold for noninferiority in hemostatic effectiveness at 24 hours after ICU admission. Additional predefined end points consistently indicated diminished hemostatic effectiveness, although prespecified adverse events were comparable.
articles.punchTr: Cerrahi kanamada dondurulmuş trombositler, sıvı saklanan trombositlere eşdeğerlik eşiğini karşılayamadı.

articles.title: Secondary Prevention After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery: 2026 Update: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association.
articles.conclusionEn: Secondary prevention strongly correlates with improved outcomes after bypass surgery, providing the rationale and urgency for this updated scientific statement to promote evidence-based practical considerations and to improve their use.
articles.punchTr: AHA 2026: CABG sonrası sekonder korunma sonuçları güçlü biçimde iyileştiriyor; güncel pratik öneriler yayımlandı.

articles.title: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation with the Trilogy valve for symptomatic native aortic regurgitation (ALIGN-AR): a pivotal, multicentre, single-arm, investigational device exemption study.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients with symptomatic moderate-to-severe or severe aortic regurgitation considered to be of high surgical risk, TAVI with a dedicated platform met prespecified safety and effectiveness performance goals.
articles.punchTr: Yüksek riskli saf aort yetmezliğinde Trilogy kapakla TAVI, önceden belirlenen güvenlik ve etkinlik hedeflerine ulaştı.

articles.title: A polygenic risk score for peripheral artery disease and major adverse limb events.
articles.conclusionEn: In a broad spectrum of patients with cardiometabolic disease, the PAD PRS is associated with an increased risk of PAD and the incidence of MALE beyond clinical risk factors; however, the improvement in discrimination was statistically significant but clinically modest.
articles.punchTr: PAH için poligenik risk skoru, klinik risk faktörlerinin ötesinde majör ekstremite olaylarını öngörüyor; katkısı ise mütevazı.

articles.title: Ten-year outcomes of valve-replacing versus valve-sparing aortic root replacement in patients with Marfan syndrome: An observational multicenter study.
articles.conclusionEn: Ten years postoperatively, the accumulation of structural valve deterioration in patients who underwent AVS and bleeding events in patients who underwent AVR balance out in terms of MAVRE.
articles.punchTr: Marfan'da 10 yılda kapak koruyucu ile kapak değiştiren kök replasmanının majör kapak olayları dengeleniyor.

articles.title: Editor's Choice - Aquaporin-4: A Predictor and Therapeutic Target for Permanent Paraplegia after Endovascular Thoraco-abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair.
articles.conclusionEn: The AQP4 level in the CSF of a patient represents a prognostic marker of permanent paraplegia after TAAA repair and highlights a novel therapeutic target. These findings represent a conceptual advance in the management of iSCI.
articles.punchTr: BOS'taki aquaporin-4 düzeyi, TAAA onarımı sonrası kalıcı parapleji için belirteç ve yeni tedavi hedefi olabilir.

articles.title: Cerebral Ischaemic Events in Asymptomatic Carotid Stenosis under Best Medical Therapy: Five Year Results of a Prospective Study (Carotid Asymptomatic Stenosis Study).
articles.conclusionEn: ACAS patients under BMT have a relatively low CIE risk, but plaque progression and contralateral stenosis increase it. These findings may help refine indications for carotid revascularisation.
articles.punchTr: Optimal medikal tedavideki asemptomatik karotis darlığında 5 yıllık iskemik olay riski düşük; plak ilerlemesi riski artırıyor.

articles.title: Long-Term Survival Advantage of Reoperative Surgical Mitral Valve Replacement Over Transcatheter Mitral Valve-in-Valve: A Multicenter Cohort.
articles.conclusionEn: Although mViV demonstrated comparable 30-day MVARC outcomes, rSMVR was associated with superior long-term survival and hemodynamic durability among patients deemed appropriate surgical candidates by a multidisciplinary heart team. Treatment decisions should balance short-term risk with long-term outcomes.
articles.punchTr: Uygun hastada redo cerrahi mitral replasman, transkateter valve-in-valve'e göre daha uzun sağkalım ve dayanıklılık sağladı.

articles.title: Survival After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting With or Without Mitral Valve Repair for Moderate Ischemic Mitral Regurgitation.
articles.conclusionEn: In one of the largest Asian real-world cohorts, concomitant mitral valve repair during CABG for moderate IMR was associated with lower mortality and fewer major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events and greater echocardiographic improvement but at the expense of increased perioperative morbidity.
articles.punchTr: Orta iskemik MY'de CABG'ye mitral tamir eklemek mortaliteyi azalttı, ancak perioperatif morbiditeyi artırdı.

articles.title: Debranching versus Fenestrated Repair for Left Subclavian Artery Revascularisation during Thoracic Endovascular Aortic Repair: The DEFENCE Multicentre Study.
articles.conclusionEn: CSB-TEVAR and FTEVAR achieved high technical success, long term durability, and similar mortality rates. FTEVAR is a durable, low re-intervention alternative, while CSB-TEVAR remains a practical option in urgent cases despite its higher incidence of peri-operative and access related morbidity.
articles.punchTr: Sol subklavyen revaskülarizasyonunda fenestre TEVAR, debranching'e göre daha az yeniden girişim gerektiren dayanıklı bir seçenek.

articles.title: Long-Term Outcomes of Open Mitral Commissurotomy vs Mechanical Mitral Valve Replacement in Rheumatic Mitral Stenosis.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients with severe MS, open mitral commissurotomy provides comparable long-term clinical outcomes to MVR and is associated with fewer bleeding events and no infective endocarditis. These findings support open mitral commissurotomy as a reasonable valve-preserving option in selected patients.
articles.punchTr: Ağır romatizmal mitral darlıkta açık komissürotomi, mekanik replasmanla benzer uzun dönem sonuç ve daha az kanama sağladı.

articles.title: Evaluation of Left Ventricular Function for Risk Stratification in Asymptomatic Severe Aortic Stenosis With Preserved Contractility.
articles.conclusionEn: AVR in asymptomatic patients with severe aortic stenosis improved outcomes with specific echocardiographic parameters as risk factors including higher E/é, indexed LV end-diastolic volume, and indexed LV end-systolic volume.
articles.punchTr: Asemptomatik ağır aort darlığında E/é ve sol ventrikül hacimleri yüksek olanlarda erken AVR sonuçları iyileştirdi.

articles.title: Trends in Utilization and Outcomes of Ross, Transcatheter, and Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement in Adults Younger Than 65 Years Old.
articles.conclusionEn: Ross use in adults aged <65 years is rising and confers lower 6-year mortality rates than SAVR-bio or TAVR, supporting broader consideration for younger patients.
articles.punchTr: 65 yaş altında Ross ameliyatı yükselişte; 6 yıllık mortalite biyoprotez SAVR ve TAVR'dan düşük.

articles.title: Early Multicentre Experience with Exclusively Retrograde Multiple Branched Endovascular Aortic Arch Repair.
articles.conclusionEn: Endovascular aortic arch repair with exclusively retrograde inner branches is feasible with acceptable technical success and no branch related re-intervention.
articles.punchTr: Yalnızca retrograd iç dallı endovasküler arkus onarımı uygulanabilir; dal ilişkili yeniden girişim görülmedi.

articles.title: Electromagnetic Intraoperative Positioning System (IOPS) Is Safe and Effective as a 3D Imaging Adjunct in Endovascular Aortic Surgery-A Safety and Feasibility Study.
articles.conclusionEn: The electromagnetic-based (IOPS is safe and effective in providing adjunctive 3D guidance for wire and catheter manipulation in infrarenal and fenestrated endovascular abdominal aortic aneurysm repair in humans.
articles.punchTr: Elektromanyetik IOPS sistemi, EVAR ve FEVAR'da tel-kateter yönlendirmesi için güvenli ve etkili 3B rehber.

articles.title: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists are associated with reduced abdominal aortic aneurysm-related events.
articles.conclusionEn: GLP-1RA prescriptions were associated with a lower risk of clinically important events in patients with unruptured AAA. These findings suggest potential benefits of GLP-1RAs in AAA management, warranting further research on their effect on aneurysm growth and progression.
articles.punchTr: GLP-1 agonisti kullanan AAA hastalarında anevrizma ilişkili klinik olay riski daha düşük bulundu.

articles.title: Low-Dose Rivaroxaban and Cardiovascular Events in Advanced Kidney Disease: The TRACK Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients with advanced CKD at high cardiovascular risk, low-dose rivaroxaban did not reduce the risk of a composite cardiovascular outcome. Major bleeding rates were significantly higher in the low-dose rivaroxaban group compared with the placebo group.
articles.punchTr: İleri KBH'de düşük doz rivaroksaban kardiyovasküler olayları azaltmadı, majör kanamayı ise artırdı.

articles.title: Lipoprotein apheresis in the era of new lipid-lowering therapies.
articles.conclusionEn: In these clinical settings, prospective, randomized clinical trials are therefore warranted.
articles.punchTr: Yeni lipid düşürücüler çağında lipoprotein aferezinin yeri için randomize çalışmalara ihtiyaç var.

articles.title: Editor's Choice - Early Improvement in Wound, Ischaemia, and foot Infection (WIfI) Ischaemia Grade Lowers Risk of Major Amputation following Revascularisation for Chronic Limb Threatening Ischaemia.
articles.conclusionEn: Achieving early improvement in limb perfusion based on WIfI ischaemia grade predicts major amputation following revascularisation independent of other risk factors.
articles.punchTr: Revaskülarizasyon sonrası WIfI iskemi derecesinde erken düzelme, majör amputasyon riskinin bağımsız göstergesi.

articles.title: National Diagnostic Reference Levels for Endovascular Aneurysm Repair in Sweden.
articles.conclusionEn: The current report proposes a DRL for DAP of 152.6 Gy·cm2 for EVAR procedures in Sweden, with specific benchmark DAP values proposed for subgroups of patients.
articles.punchTr: İsveç EVAR için ulusal radyasyon referans düzeyini belirledi: DAP 152,6 Gy·cm².

articles.title: Prospective, Multicentre Physician Initiated Trial Investigating the BeGraft Stent Graft as Bridging Stent in Fenestrated Endovascular Aortic Repair for Complex Aortic Aneurysms.
articles.conclusionEn: This study demonstrated favourable short term outcomes of the BeGraft Stent Graft as a BSG in FEVAR with good primary patency and low rates of BSG related complications.
articles.punchTr: FEVAR'da köprü stent olarak BeGraft, kısa dönemde iyi açıklık ve düşük komplikasyon gösterdi.

articles.title: Accuracy and Applicability of Motor Evoked Potential Monitoring during Open Thoraco-Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair.
articles.conclusionEn: MEP monitoring is an excellent method, providing a proper execution and a compatible anaesthetic protocol, for detecting acute peri-operative SCI and greatly influences decision making to prevent acute SCI during open TAAA procedures, although delayed SCI remains an important factor that may not be detected by MEP changes alone, largely owing to factors occurring post-operatively.
articles.punchTr: Açık TAAA cerrahisinde MEP izlemi akut omurilik iskemisini yakalamada mükemmel; geç iskemiyi ise kaçırabiliyor.

articles.title: Editor's Choice - A National Study on Burnout and Pain in Vascular Surgery.
articles.conclusionEn: This national study showed that pain during or after surgery is frequent among VS/VST and that it is significantly associated with burnout. Creating work conditions that mitigate pain and burnout is essential to support occupational health and to maintain a robust vascular surgical service.
articles.punchTr: Damar cerrahlarında ameliyat sırası ve sonrası ağrı sık ve tükenmişlikle anlamlı ilişkili.

articles.title: Influence of Malignant Neoplasms on Limb Prognosis in Patients with Peripheral Arterial Disease: A Real World Analysis Based on a Nationwide Database.
articles.conclusionEn: Approximately 2% of patients with PAD complicated by CLTI had a malignant neoplasm at the time of revascularisation.
articles.punchTr: KLTI nedeniyle revaskülarize edilen PAH hastalarının yaklaşık %2'sinde eşlik eden malignite var.

articles.title: Long Term Target Vessel Outcomes in Patients Treated with Fenestrated Endovascular Aortic Repair.
articles.conclusionEn: Target vessel performance in FEVAR demonstrated high long term freedom from adverse events, highlighting the effectiveness of the technique. TAAA was found to negatively affect outcomes, as well as previous open or endovascular abdominal aortic procedures.
articles.punchTr: FEVAR'da hedef damarlar uzun dönemde yüksek oranda sorunsuz; TAAA ve önceki aort girişimleri sonucu kötüleştiriyor.

articles.title: Open Surgery of the Descending Thoracic Aorta in the Endovascular Era: A Single Centre Experience.
articles.conclusionEn: In selected patients, open DTA repair may be required when endovascular treatment is unfeasible or considered inappropriate. In experienced centres, it yields very low mortality and complication rates and should therefore still be considered as part of the treatment armamentarium.
articles.punchTr: Endovasküler çağda da deneyimli merkezde açık inen aort cerrahisi çok düşük mortalite ve komplikasyonla yapılabiliyor.

articles.title: Geometrical Analysis and Initial Experience With Bentley's BeFlared Bridging Stent for Fenestrated Endovascular Aneurysm Repair.
articles.conclusionEn: BeFlared demonstrated favorable short-term outcomes, with notable reductions in operative time, radiation exposure, and device manipulation.
articles.punchTr: BeFlared köprü stent FEVAR'da ameliyat süresini, radyasyonu ve cihaz manipülasyonunu azalttı.

articles.journal: J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord
articles.title: Effect of obesity on endovenous ablation outcomes in the Vascular Quality Initiative.
articles.conclusionEn: Given the difficulty of achieving meaningful weight loss, delaying venous procedures until weight loss is achieved may prevent patients from receiving indicated and effective treatment.
articles.punchTr: Obez hastada venöz ablasyonu kilo verilene kadar ertelemek, etkili ve endike tedaviden mahrum bırakabilir.

articles.title: Statewide Quality Collaborative As a Forum for Change: Promoting Adoption of Multiarterial Grafting in Coronary Artery Bypass Graft Surgery.
articles.conclusionEn: Statewide surgeon-led collaborative quality improvement efforts continue to drive MAG adoption in isolated CABG operations in Michigan.
articles.punchTr: Michigan'da cerrah liderliğindeki kalite işbirliği, izole CABG'de çoklu arter greft kullanımını artırmaya devam ediyor.

articles.title: Robotic Mitral Valve Repair and Simultaneous On-Pump Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting to the Left Anterior Descending Artery.
articles.conclusionEn: This approach demonstrates the feasibility and potential clinical utility of robotic, minimally invasive surgery in appropriately selected patients with mitral valve disease complicated by LAD lesions, expanding the therapeutic possibilities for this challenging patient population.
articles.punchTr: LAD lezyonlu mitral hastalığında robotik mitral tamir ve eş zamanlı LAD bypass uygulanabilir ve umut verici.

articles.title: Progression from Minor to Major Amputation in Patients with Diabetes and Peripheral Arterial Disease: Risk Factors and Clinical Trajectories.
articles.conclusionEn: Progression to major amputation after minor amputation is common and occurs early in patients with DM and PAD.
articles.punchTr: Diyabet ve PAH'ta minör amputasyondan majöre ilerleme sık ve erken görülüyor.

articles.title: Frozen elephant trunk for acute type A aortic dissection: long-term outcomes over two decades.
articles.conclusionEn: In this series spanning two decades, the FET + TAR technique achieved satisfactory long-term survival and freedom from reintervention in patients with ATAAD, showing lower risk of late death, reoperation and distal aortic dilation compared to hemiarch repair.
articles.punchTr: Akut tip A diseksiyonda frozen elephant trunk, hemiarka göre geç ölüm, reoperasyon ve distal genişleme riskini azalttı.

articles.title: Mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair and outcomes according to baseline health status: the RESHAPE-HF2 trial.
articles.conclusionEn: In patients with HF and moderate-to-severe vSMR, M-TEER showed a consistent trend towards a lower risk of HF hospitalization, with or without cardiovascular death, across all KCCQ-CSS tertiles and improved health status over time.
articles.punchTr: Kalp yetmezliği ve ciddi sekonder MY'de M-TEER, başlangıçtaki sağlık durumundan bağımsız olarak yatışları azaltma eğiliminde.

articles.title: Endovascular Therapy for Post-Thrombotic Syndrome - A Randomized Trial.
articles.conclusionEn: Among patients with moderate or severe post-thrombotic syndrome and iliac-vein obstruction, endovascular therapy led to less severe post-thrombotic syndrome and better health-related quality of life than standard care over a 6-month period but with a higher risk of bleeding.
articles.punchTr: C-TRACT: iliyak ven tıkanıklıklı post-trombotik sendromda endovasküler tedavi semptomu ve yaşam kalitesini iyileştirdi; kanama riski arttı.

articles.title: Ten-year experience in the endovascular repair of complex and thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysms by an off-the-shelf multibranched thoracoabdominal endograft.
articles.conclusionEn: Endovascular repair of CAAAs and TAAAs by T-Branch is effective with excellent early outcomes and satisfactory midterm TA instability, reinterventions, and survival. Predictors of early/midterm failures were identified, and they should be considered to optimize patient selection and postoperative management.
articles.punchTr: T-Branch ile kompleks ve torakoabdominal anevrizma onarımı etkili; erken sonuçlar mükemmel, orta dönem tatmin edici.

articles.title: Arterial Cannulation and Brain Perfusion Strategies for Acute Type A Dissection in North America.
articles.conclusionEn: Despite positive trends in ATAAD repair, these did not translate into overall improved mortality.
articles.punchTr: Kuzey Amerika'da tip A diseksiyon onarımındaki olumlu gelişmeler genel mortaliteyi düşürmeye yansımadı.

articles.title: Twenty-Five Years of Open Type A Aortic Dissection Repair: Influence of Surgical Evolution and Patient Selection on Outcomes.
articles.conclusionEn: ATAAD surgery has become more complex, with increased use of arch repairs and advanced neuroprotection strategies. Despite an older, higher-risk cohort, surgical outcomes remain stable. Axillary artery cannulation was associated with improved survival.
articles.punchTr: 25 yıllık açık tip A diseksiyon cerrahisi: hastalar yaşlansa da sonuçlar stabil; aksiller kanülasyon sağkalımı iyileştirdi.

articles.title: Angiography-derived fractional flow reserve versus coronary angiography to guide coronary artery bypass grafting in patients undergoing surgical valve procedures with concomitant coronary artery disease in China (FAVOR IV-QVAS): a multicentre, triple-blind, randomised trial.
articles.conclusionEn: Among patients undergoing valve surgery with concomitant coronary artery disease, physiologically guided CABG using angiography-derived FFR reduced the incidence of the composite perioperative outcome compared with anatomically guided CABG.
articles.punchTr: Kapak cerrahisiyle birlikte CABG'de anjiyografi kaynaklı FFR rehberliği, perioperatif olayları anatomik rehbere göre azalttı.

articles.title: Editor's Choice - Dynamic Risk of Death following Application of Paclitaxel Coated Devices in the Femoropopliteal Artery: A Contemporary Meta-analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials.
articles.conclusionEn: There is a significant, dynamic increase in all cause mortality following application of paclitaxel coated devices in the femoropopliteal artery.
articles.punchTr: Femoropoplitealde paklitaksel kaplı cihaz sonrası tüm nedenlere bağlı mortalitede anlamlı ve dinamik artış saptandı.

articles.title: Targeting P2Y14R alleviates platelet-induced NET formation and venous thrombosis through PKA/AKAP13/RhoA axis.
articles.conclusionEn: Neutrophil P2Y14R deficiency regulates PKA/AKAP13/RhoA pathway to inhibit neutrophil-platelet aggregate, thereby reducing NET release and venous thrombosis. This indicates that P2Y14R may be a potential therapeutic target for the intervention of VTE using P2Y14R antagonists, including proglumide.
articles.punchTr: Nötrofil P2Y14R'sini hedeflemek NET oluşumunu ve venöz trombozu azaltıyor; proglumid VTE'de yeni seçenek olabilir.

articles.title: Radiation Exposure during Elective Endovascular Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Repair: A Nationwide Study of Patient Doses in Finland.
articles.conclusionEn: Surprisingly high, up to six fold, between centre variability in total procedure radiation exposure was observed.
articles.punchTr: Elektif EVAR'da merkezler arası radyasyon dozu farkı şaşırtıcı biçimde 6 kata kadar çıkıyor.

articles.title: Survival After Mechanical vs Biological Mitral Valve Replacement: Influence of Age vs Operative Mortality Score.
articles.conclusionEn: Contrary to some guidelines, mechanical MVR showed significant survival benefit in patients up to age 70 years with low PROM, but survival benefit was not significant for PROM 9% or more at any age. Valve selection should be individualized considering both patient age and PROM in addition to other factors.
articles.punchTr: Düşük operatif riskte 70 yaşa kadar mekanik mitral replasman, biyolojiğe göre anlamlı sağkalım avantajı sağladı.

articles.title: Combined transcatheter mitral and tricuspid edge-to-edge repair or tricuspid edge-to-edge repair alone in moderate mitral regurgitation: a propensity-matched analysis.
articles.conclusionEn: Moderate MR predicts impaired prognosis in patients undergoing T-TEER for treatment of severe TR.
articles.punchTr: Ciddi TR için T-TEER yapılan hastalarda eşlik eden orta MY kötü prognozun habercisi.

articles.title: Sirolimus-Coated Balloon Angioplasty for Infrainguinal Artery Disease.
articles.conclusionEn: Among patients with infrainguinal artery disease undergoing endovascular treatment, angioplasty with sirolimus-coated balloons led to a lower incidence of major adverse limb events at 1 year than angioplasty with uncoated balloons.
articles.punchTr: SirPAD: inguinal altı arter hastalığında sirolimus kaplı balon, 1 yılda majör ekstremite olaylarını kaplamasız balona göre azalttı.

articles.title: Percutaneous coronary intervention versus coronary artery bypass grafting for unprotected left main stenosis: 10-year final results from the randomised, open-label, non-inferiority NOBLE trial.
articles.conclusionEn: There was no significant difference in all-cause mortality at 10 years between PCI and CABG for patients with unprotected left main coronary artery disease and no additional complex lesions, indicating that PCI is equally as safe as CABG in patients eligible for both treatments.
articles.punchTr: Korunmasız sol ana koroner hastalıkta PCI ile CABG arasında 10 yıllık tüm nedenli ölümde fark çıkmadı.

articles.title: Efficacy and safety of REGN9933A2 and REGN7508Cat for preventing postoperative venous thromboembolism (ROXI-VTE-I and ROXI-VTE-II): two randomised, open-label, phase 2 trials.
articles.conclusionEn: REGN7508Cat was superior to enoxaparin for venous thromboembolism prevention; REGN9933A2 was not superior to enoxaparin. The findings with REGN7508Cat confirm the role of FXI in postoperative venous thromboembolism, and the findings with REGN9933A2 suggest that FXIIa-driven FXI activation contributes to this process.
articles.punchTr: Postoperatif VTE profilaksisinde FXI hedefli REGN7508Cat enoksaparinden üstün bulundu.

articles.title: Real-World Outcomes of Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement: Analysis From the STS/ACC TVT Registry.
articles.conclusionEn: Early US real-world experience with TTVR confirms safety and effectiveness in patients with severe TR.
articles.punchTr: ABD gerçek yaşam verisi: ciddi triküspit yetmezliğinde transkateter triküspit replasman güvenli ve etkili.

articles.title: Early Surgery or Conservative Care for Asymptomatic Aortic Stenosis at 10 Years.
articles.conclusionEn: Among asymptomatic patients with very severe aortic stenosis, early surgery led to a lower risk of a composite of operative mortality or death from cardiovascular causes than conservative care at 10 years.
articles.punchTr: RECOVERY 10 yıl: çok ağır asemptomatik aort darlığında erken cerrahi, kardiyovasküler ölümü bekle-gör yaklaşımına göre azalttı.

articles.title: Deep vein thrombosis exacerbated by syndecan-4 shedding and piezo1-dependent endothelial-mesenchymal transition.
articles.conclusionEn: SDC4 shedding exacerbates DVT by promoting Piezo1-dependent EndMT via PI3K/Akt signalling. Quercetin shows therapeutic potential as a Piezo1 inhibitor.
articles.punchTr: Sindekan-4 dökülmesi Piezo1 üzerinden DVT'yi ağırlaştırıyor; kuersetin Piezo1 inhibitörü olarak umut vadediyor.

articles.title: The Association Between Hospital Comprehensive Stroke Center Designation Status and Stroke Rate Reporting in the Society of Thoracic Surgeons/American College of Cardiology Transcatheter Valve Therapy Registry After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: Implications for Hospital Performance Assessment.
articles.conclusionEn: CSC hospital status and participation in TAVR trials are significant predictors unique for stroke.
articles.punchTr: TAVR'da bildirilen inme oranı, hastanenin kapsamlı inme merkezi olmasıyla ve TAVR çalışmalarına katılımıyla ilişkili.

articles.title: EACTS Expert Consensus Document on aortic valve repair and valve-sparing aortic root replacement procedures.
articles.conclusionEn: This document presents the official stance of the EACTS and aims to promote standardized, evidence-based decision-making in the management of patients undergoing aortic valve repair.
articles.punchTr: EACTS uzlaşı raporu: aort kapak tamiri ve kapak koruyucu kök replasmanında standart, kanıta dayalı karar rehberi.

articles.title: Association of Completion Imaging Modalities and Carotid Endarterectomy Outcomes in the Vascular Quality Initiative.
articles.conclusionEn: Re-exploration and stroke outcomes after completion imaging reflect each modality's safety and efficacy in detecting significant technical defects.
articles.punchTr: Karotis endarterektomide tamamlayıcı görüntüleme yönteminin seçimi, re-eksplorasyon ve inme sonuçlarını etkiliyor.

articles.title: Variation and temporal trends in Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Group billing for carotid endarterectomy across Vascular Quality Initiative centers.
articles.conclusionEn: Substantial variation exists for MS-DRG billing for CEA across VQI centers.
articles.punchTr: Karotis endarterektomi için faturalandırma (MS-DRG) VQI merkezleri arasında büyük farklılık gösteriyor.

articles.title: Early Outcomes of Thoracic Branch Endoprosthesis in Aortic Arch Pathologies: A Nordic Multicentre Study.
articles.conclusionEn: TBE demonstrated high technical success and acceptable early outcomes across a range of aortic arch pathologies. However, the relatively high rate of endoleaks and need for early re-interventions highlight the importance of careful patient selection and close continuous post-operative surveillance.
articles.punchTr: Arkus patolojilerinde torakal dallı endoprotez teknik olarak başarılı, ancak endoleak ve erken yeniden girişim oranı yüksek.

articles.title: Early and follow-up results of reinterventions for type 2 endoleak following endovascular repair of abdominal aortic aneurysm (EVAR): the multicenter REinterventions for Type 2 Endoleak (RETE) study.
articles.conclusionEn: Reinterventions for T2ELs are safe, with satisfactory immediate technical success and low perioperative mortality.
articles.punchTr: EVAR sonrası tip 2 endoleak için yeniden girişimler güvenli; teknik başarı iyi, perioperatif mortalite düşük.

articles.title: Differences in Clinical Presentation of Chronic Pelvic Pain Caused by Iliac Vein Obstruction Impacts Referral Pathway, Time to Diagnosis, and Post-stenting Pain Resolution.
articles.conclusionEn: All patients had a reproducible pattern of venous origin pelvic pain, but those with worse CPP, more abdominopelvic symptoms, and less varicose veins had a more complex and delayed referral pathway and the lowest pain resolution.
articles.punchTr: İliyak ven tıkanıklığına bağlı pelvik ağrıda varisi az, semptomu ağır hastalar geç tanı alıyor ve en az düzelme gösteriyor.

articles.title: Long Term Results of Surgical Treatment of Chronic Venous Thoracic Outlet Syndrome: A Single Centre Experience.
articles.conclusionEn: Chronic VTOS can be effectively treated with good long term functional outcomes. Re-PTAs were necessary in half of the cases (anticipated). This treatment algorithm diminished the need of secondary interventions in 50% of the cases, as well as the need for long term anticoagulation usage.
articles.punchTr: Kronik venöz torasik çıkış sendromu cerrahiyle uzun dönemde iyi fonksiyonel sonuçla tedavi edilebiliyor.

articles.title: Efficacy and Safety of No Thromboprophylaxis after Endovenous Radiofrequency Ablation for Incompetent Saphenous VeiNs: the TRAIN Non-inferiority Randomised Controlled Trial.
articles.conclusionEn: Omitting extended post-operative rivaroxaban thromboprophylaxis after RFA with concomitant phlebectomy and sclerotherapy in patients without previous DVT was non-inferior to fourteen days of rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily for thrombosis related events.
articles.punchTr: RFA, flebektomi ve skleroterapi sonrası DVT öyküsü yoksa rivaroksaban profilaksisi atlanabilir: 14 günlük tedaviden aşağı kalmadı.

articles.title: In-hospital vascular surgery consultation is associated with improved follow-up and earlier identification of aneurysmal degeneration after acute Type A aortic dissection.
articles.conclusionEn: Vascular surgery consultation is associated with increased identification of aneurysmal degeneration, planned secondary interventions, and mid-term survival.
articles.punchTr: Hastane içi damar cerrahisi konsültasyonu, anevrizmal dejenerasyonun erken saptanması ve daha iyi orta dönem sağkalımla ilişkili.

articles.title: Sex-specific association between preoperative foot infection and vein graft stenosis after distal bypass for chronic limb-threatening ischemia.
articles.conclusionEn: Women undergoing single-vein distal bypass for chronic limb-threatening ischemia have a higher incidence of vein graft stenosis despite balanced baseline risk, with the excess concentrated in those with preoperative foot infection.
articles.punchTr: KLTI'de distal bypass yapılan kadınlarda ven greft darlığı daha sık; fark, ameliyat öncesi ayak enfeksiyonu olanlarda yoğunlaşıyor.

articles.title: Multicenter Outcomes of Peripheral Vascular Interventions in Patients with Active Cancer.
articles.conclusionEn: Active cancer affects a small proportion of patients undergoing PVI but has a significant impact on perioperative limb outcomes and long-term survival. This multicenter collaboration, combining registry data and EMR review, can shed light on less common risk factors affecting lower extremity revascularization.
articles.punchTr: Aktif kanseri olan hastalarda periferik girişimler ekstremite sonuçlarını ve uzun dönem sağkalımı belirgin kötüleştiriyor.

articles.title: Outcomes among Patients with Single-Vessel Tibial Runoff Undergoing Revascularization for Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia, and the Role of Peroneal Communicating Branch Quality.
articles.conclusionEn: Peroneal runoff is independently associated with worse limb outcomes following revascularization for CLTI, but this risk may be primarily driven by patients with absent or diminutive communicating branches.
articles.punchTr: KLTI revaskülarizasyonunda tek peroneal akım kötü ekstremite sonucuyla ilişkili; risk iletişim dalları zayıf olanlarda.

articles.title: Patient-Surgeon Sex Concordance Affects Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting Outcomes.
articles.conclusionEn: Female surgeons performed CABG on patients with higher comorbidity burden than male surgeons. While female patients had lower 30-day mortality with male surgeons, survival curves crossed at 90-days, after which survival was superior with female surgeons.
articles.punchTr: CABG'de cerrah-hasta cinsiyet uyumu: kadın cerrahların hastalarında 90. günden sonra sağkalım daha iyi.

articles.title: One year outcomes of Percutaneous Deep Vein Arterialization in the Dutch LimFlow Registry.
articles.conclusionEn: pDVA in NO-CLTI patients is safe and effective at 12 months, preventing major amputation and mortality in the majority of patients. QoL also appeared to improve following pDVA. These observations warrant confirmation in larger studies.
articles.punchTr: Seçeneksiz KLTI'de perkütan derin ven arteryalizasyonu 12 ayda hastaların çoğunda majör amputasyonu önledi.

articles.title: Real-world outcomes of endoanchors in the prevention and treatment of proximal endograft failure in a multicenter registry.
articles.conclusionEn: In this real-world registry, ESAR was used as an adjunct during primary EVAR in patients with a hostile proximal neck and as a salvage treatment of proximal endograft failure after a previous EVAR, with favorable success rates in both settings.
articles.punchTr: Endoanchor'lar, zor proksimal boyunlu EVAR'da ve proksimal greft yetmezliğinin kurtarılmasında başarılı.

articles.title: Outcomes of thoracic endovascular aortic repair for uncomplicated subacute type B aortic dissection in the IRAD registry.
articles.conclusionEn: Compared with BMT, sTEVAR led to similar survival rates. New dissection was higher in the sTEVAR group. TEVAR may have a role in uncomplicated subacute TBAAD, and further randomized trials are essential to identify which patients benefit from this intervention.
articles.punchTr: Komplike olmayan subakut tip B diseksiyonda TEVAR, medikal tedaviyle benzer sağkalım sağladı; yeni diseksiyon daha sık.

articles.journal: J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord
articles.title: Update of a Living Network Meta-Analysis Comparing Non-compounded Polidocanol 1% Endovenous Microfoam (Varithena) Ablation versus Endovenous Thermal Ablation in Chronic Venous Insufficiency.
articles.conclusionEn: This living network meta-analysis update reinforced the original findings that polidocanol 1% endovenous microfoam is not statistically different from endovenous thermal ablation for venous closure or deep venous thrombosis in the treatment of chronic venous insufficiency, and adds new preliminary information on outcomes relevant to the patient experience.
articles.punchTr: Polidokanol %1 mikroköpük, KVY'de venöz kapanma ve DVT açısından termal ablasyondan istatistiksel olarak farklı değil.

articles.title: Lifetime Management of Aortic Stenosis: Expert Review of Evidence and Consensus Guidelines.
articles.conclusionEn: This review supports appropriate application of current guidelines through a pragmatic framework for individualized, Heart Team-based decision-making.
articles.punchTr: Aort darlığının ömür boyu yönetimi: Kalp Ekibi temelli bireysel karar için pratik bir çerçeve önerildi.

articles.title: Simultaneous Versus Staged Surgery for Concomitant Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm and Gastrointestinal Malignancy: A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis.
articles.conclusionEn: Simultaneous and staged approaches to the treatment of concomitant AAA and GI cancer showed no significant differences in short- or long-term mortality or disease-related complications.
articles.punchTr: AAA ve eş zamanlı GİS kanserinde tek seanslı ya da aşamalı cerrahi arasında mortalite ve komplikasyon farkı yok.

articles.title: Early Experience of Fiber Optic RealShape Technology in Endovascular Interventions for Peripheral Artery Disease: A Prospective Single-Center Study.
articles.conclusionEn: Fiber Optic RealShape-guided navigation and lesion crossing in PAD interventions is feasible and safe.
articles.punchTr: PAH girişimlerinde fiber optik RealShape ile 3B yönlendirme ve lezyon geçişi uygulanabilir ve güvenli.

articles.title: One Year Survival of High-Risk Patients Undergoing Coronary Revascularization.
articles.conclusionEn: In high-risk CABG, prognostic determinants evolve over time. These findings underscore the importance of incorporating temporal risk dynamics into clinical decisions.
articles.punchTr: Yüksek riskli CABG'de prognozu belirleyen faktörler zamanla değişiyor; kararlarda bu dinamik dikkate alınmalı.

articles.journal: J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord
articles.title: A pilot study of the InVera Infusion Device: Twelve-month outcomes in the treatment of incompetent saphenous veins.
articles.conclusionEn: The InVera Infusion device provides a safe and effective technique for the delivery of sclerosant agents as part of the management of incompetent saphenous veins, demonstrating favorable 12-month anatomical, clinical and patient reported outcomes in this pilot cohort.
articles.punchTr: InVera infüzyon cihazıyla safen ven skleroterapisi pilot çalışmada 12 ayda güvenli ve etkili bulundu.

articles.journal: J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord
articles.title: NON-INVASIVE HemodynamicS of Non-Thrombotic Iliac Vein Lesions ARE DISTURBED IN PATIEnTS with A HiSTORY OF Deep Venous Thrombosis.
articles.conclusionEn: Among patients with NIVL, decreased velocity through the left common iliac vein at the compression point was the strongest predictor of prior DVT whereas percent stenosis was less discriminative.
articles.punchTr: Trombotik olmayan iliyak ven lezyonunda geçmiş DVT'yi en iyi öngören, darlık yüzdesi değil sıkışma noktasındaki akım hızı.

articles.title: Retrieval of Thrombosed Inferior Vena Cava Filter and Mechanical Thrombectomy of Associated Caval Thrombosis Using FlowTriever and ClotTriever Systems With the ClotTriever as Embolic Protection.
articles.conclusionEn: This report illustrates the alternative use of the ClotTriever BOLD as an intra-operative proximal embolic protection in the absence of alternative devices like a ProTrieve sheath, during caval thrombectomy and removal for caval thrombosis secondary to an IVC filter.Clinical ImpactThe ClotTriever BOLD catheter, deployed alongside a large retrograde sheath may be considered as an proximal embolic protection for removing thrombosed IVCFs, where there is patient with a suitably sized IVC and when alternative and appropriate devices are unavailable.
articles.punchTr: Trombozlu VKİ filtresi çıkarılırken ClotTriever BOLD, proksimal emboli koruması olarak alternatif bir çözüm sunuyor.

articles.title: Transcarotid Access for Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement With the Evolut Self-Expanding Valve: Outcomes from a Real-World Registry.
articles.conclusionEn: Transcarotid TAVR with the Evolut TAV is an effective, safe approach for patients with unfavorable iliofemoral anatomy. Heart teams should become facile with this technique to provide optimal care across the anatomy spectrum.
articles.punchTr: Transkarotis erişimle Evolut TAVR, iliyofemoral anatomisi uygun olmayan hastalarda etkili ve güvenli.

articles.title: Current Generation Self-Expanding and Balloon-Expandable Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: A Retrospective Multicenter Analysis.
articles.conclusionEn: In this cohort, SE-THV correlated with higher rates of ischemic stroke, PPM need, and PVL during index hospitalization and increased mild and moderate PVL upon follow-up.
articles.punchTr: Kendiliğinden genişleyen TAVR kapakları, balonla genişleyenlere göre daha fazla inme, kalıcı pacemaker ve paravalvüler kaçakla ilişkili.

articles.journal: J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord
articles.title: Post-thrombotic syndrome after thrombotic venous thoracic outlet syndrome.
articles.conclusionEn: This study highlights the central role of venous patency in the clinical course of T-vTOS, with persistent subclavian vein occlusion associated with an increased risk of PTS.
articles.punchTr: Trombotik venöz TOS'ta subklavyen ven tıkalı kalırsa post-trombotik sendrom riski artıyor.

articles.journal: J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord
articles.title: A comparison of aspiration thrombectomy with catheter-directed thrombolysis in the management of Paget-Schroetter syndrome.
articles.conclusionEn: Both ASP and CDT may be employed for clearing thrombus in PSS; however, they differ in early efficacy, PTC, and patency. Our results suggest that while often more rapid and convenient, ASP may be inferior to CAT in the management of PSS.
articles.punchTr: Paget-Schroetter sendromunda aspirasyon trombektomisi daha hızlı ve pratik, ancak kateter trombolizinden daha az etkili olabilir.
